
Trends
================================================================================

Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Abundance

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$abundance, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Abundance")
```

### Recruitment

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$recruitment, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Recruitment")
```

### SSB

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$ssb, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = ssb_label)
```

### Abundance-at-age

```{r}
plot_age_year(pop$N, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "N")
```

### Average F

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$F_bar, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Average F")
```

### F-at-age

```{r}
F <- mortality_plot_data(pop$F, pop$mu_F, fits, "F")
plot_age_year(F, plot = plot_mortality,
  color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "F")
```

### Selectivity

```{r}
plot_age_year(pop$S, x = ~age, xlab = "Age", ylab = "Selectivity", frame = ~year,
           color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols)
```

### Average M

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$M_bar, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Average M")
```

### M-at-age

```{r}
M <- mortality_plot_data(pop$M, pop$mu_M, fits, "M")
plot_age_year(M, plot = plot_mortality,
  color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "M")
```
